# sh-fpv-photo-break

**Purpose:** A photo placed between sections.

**Switches:** Gate.

**Rules:** drops when the album is locked (never blurred). Tit for tat shows at half height with the nudge.

**Taps:** Upload Now (tit for tat).

Full profile view (migration, not yet core) · 4 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=2877-19691) (node `2877:19691`)

## Types

### Gate=Visible

**When:** album visible.

### Gate=Accept gated

**Not used on the FPV:** interspersed photos drop when the album is locked.

### Gate=Upgrade gated

**Not used on the FPV:** interspersed photos drop when the album is locked.

### Gate=Tit for tat

**When:** Free viewer without a photo; half height with the nudge.
